lede: Omnigroove Collective is opening the booth to beginners, with three artists it calls Bangladesh's finest leading the way.
body:
Ever wanted to learn DJing from people already playing out? A **DJ workshop in Bangladesh** presented by [@omnigroove.collective](https://www.instagram.com/omnigroove.collective/) promises exactly that, with a teaching line-up the collective describes as "Bangladesh's finest".

## Who's teaching this DJ workshop in Bangladesh

The post names three artists:

- **Psytaraa** ([@psytaraa.artist](https://www.instagram.com/psytaraa.artist/)), credited alongside [@deltatribe.bd](https://www.instagram.com/deltatribe.bd/)
- [@vampbetch_](https://www.instagram.com/vampbetch_/)
- [@momi_hoque](https://www.instagram.com/momi_hoque/)

Psytaraa's name runs across the top of the cover in bold italic type, set against a swirling teal-and-grey shape. Below it is a collage: a figure in sunglasses lit in electric blue, a psychedelic eye illustration, and a man with headphones around his neck.

## Learn the art of DJing

The caption's pitch is short: "Learn the art of DJing", and don't miss the opportunity. The hashtags (#djculture, #bangladeshidj, #raveculture, #psytara) put the workshop firmly on the rave side of the scene. The post doesn't list a date, venue, fee or number of places, so follow Omnigroove Collective for sign-up details.

## Building skills in the scene

DJ skills are often passed on informally, from one selector to the next, so a workshop opens that knowledge to anyone curious enough to show up. If you're building toward your first sets, also look at the [Hong Kong radio show opportunity for Bangladeshi DJs and producers](post:hong-kong-radio-show-bangladeshi-djs-producers) and read how [OMDG helped spark Bangladesh's rave revolution](post:omdg-dhaka-rave-revolution). Fans of psychedelic culture should meet [Lunith.Void](post:lunith-void-psychedelic-culture-dhaka) too.

There's more in [Music & Rave](topic:music) and on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcoTLefGqPT/)
